Create Entity.description: Creates an Entity in a dataset, e.g. registering a patient or household for follow-up forms.

Bulk Create Entities.description: Creates many Entities in one request, e.g. seeding a case list from another system.

Update Entity.description: Updates the label or properties of an existing Entity.

Approve Submission.description: Sets the review state of a submission, e.g. after it is processed downstream.

Comment On Submission.description: Adds a comment to a submission, e.g. to flag a sync error for reviewers.

Create App User.description: Creates an App User (data collector) in a project.

Get New Submissions.description: Gets submissions to a form received after a given date.

List Forms.description: Lists all forms in a project.
List Forms.code:
// List every form in the project.
getForms($.configuration.projectId);

List Entities.description: Lists Entities in a dataset through the OData feed, with optional filters.

Get Entity.description: Gets one Entity with its current data by uuid.

List App Users.description: Lists the App Users (data collectors) in a project.
List App Users.code:
// List App Users in a project.
get(`v1/projects/${$.configuration.projectId}/app-users`);
